# Harbor background assets (CC0) — provenance

Copied 2026-11-04 (unmodified) from an internal asset folder (`Harbor_v3/{polyhaven,innerscene}/`).
All 21 file SHA256 values (listed in `SHA256SUMS_harbor_assets.txt`) were checked equal to the upstream `SOURCE.md` records.

| folder | asset | upstream page | license | use in simulator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PolyHaven/ocean_buoy | Ocean buoy | https://polyhaven.com/a/ocean_buoy | CC0 (https://polyhaven.com/license) | outer channel buoys (non-vessel, hard-negative candidates) |
| PolyHaven/lateral_sea_marker | Lateral sea marker | https://polyhaven.com/a/lateral_sea_marker | CC0 | inner channel marks (non-vessel) |
| PolyHaven/coastal_cliff_01 | Coastal cliff | https://polyhaven.com/a/coastal_cliff_01 | CC0 | distant headland backdrop (scaled) |
| PolyHaven/coast_rocks_05_textures | Coast rocks 05 — **textures only** (diff / nor_gl / arm) | https://polyhaven.com/a/coast_rocks_05 | CC0 | texture for procedurally generated low-poly armour rocks (the 400k-vertex scan mesh is not used) |
| InnersceneHarbor/innerscene_godown_warehouse.glb | Godown warehouse 30 x 20 m | https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/godown-warehouse-30-x-20-m-with-loading-dock-3d-model-c8599c4b | CC0 (https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/terms) | warehouses on the east quay |
| InnersceneHarbor/innerscene_mobile_crane.glb | Mobile crane | https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/mobile-crane-c2eb1d41 | CC0 | parked harbor mobile crane (decoration/occluder) |

Not used: `coast_line_01`, `coast_rocks_05` mesh, `overhead_crane` (workshop gantry, not a port crane), tower crane (construction crane), container STEP files (not importable).
Everything else in the harbor (STS cranes, RTGs, containers, quays, bollards, fenders, lighting masts, buildings, beacons, skyline, rocks) is procedural code in `Runtime/Harbor*.cs`; textures are generated by `Editor/ProceduralTextures.cs`.
